name: Yellowstone Shield
summary: Solana program that manages on-chain allowlists and blocklists to control transaction forwarding.
description: An on-chain Solana program that manages allowlists and blocklists of identities, where an identity is any addressable account such as a validator, wallet or program, so transaction senders can control which leaders receive transactions. It adds a forwardingPolicies parameter and an optional Solana-ForwardingPolicies header to the sendTransaction RPC method, and ships JavaScript and Rust SDKs, a CLI for creating policies and adding or removing identities, and a Rust policy store for real-time checks. Policies are bound to a Token Extensions asset carrying name, symbol and URI.
contains: on-chain allowlists and blocklists for any addressable Solana identity
